definitions.omega_cutoff: (N + |beta|)/spacing, the CFL resolution of the room
definitions.omega_zero: N/r, the angular ground of the room

reading: The bottom and top ends of a room are both set by the local space. For the recorded states the room quality is many orders of magnitude larger at the inner edge than at the outer boundary in this flat-slice gauge, so the recorded states hold a sharper room at the bottom than at the top. This is a reading of measured numbers, not a derivation of Planck's constant or of absolute zero.
